faq_heading: Cedar Hills houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Cedar Hills. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Cedar Hills, Surrey: 51 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 14 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 27%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 11 of 15 Surrey communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Cedar Hills fell from 73 in June to 51 in October (−30.1%), and 34 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 4.9% of Surrey’s 1,033 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Cedar Hills?
Cedar Hills also had 9 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in October, against 51 houses listed. The Cedar Hills condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Cedar Hills home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

57 houses sold in Cedar Hills with a median price of $1,100,000 (the middle half sold between $1,000,000 and $1,345,500), taking a median of 44 days to sell at 94.1% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $445 per square foot, a median year built of 1964 and a median lot of 7,560 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Cedar Hills?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 51 houses listed in Cedar Hills. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Cedar Hills a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Cedar Hills had a sales ratio of 27%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Cedar Hills from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 34 houses sold in Cedar Hills over those 5 months, out of 464 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Cedar Hills?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Cedar Hills sell for?
faq.a: 57 houses sold in Cedar Hills between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,100,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Cedar Hills?
faq.a: The median was 44 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.1% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
